source: Cleanview, 'Bypassing the Grid' (2026). Cleanview reports identified behind-the-meter equipment by manufacturer; those figures are not redistributed here at Cleanview's request.
basis: Share of the ~27 GW of planned off-grid data-center capacity with identified equipment, grouped into technologies by us (Caterpillar recips and Jenbacher as engines; GE Vernova, Solar Turbines and ProEnergy as simple-cycle turbines; Bloom as fuel cells). About 6% is unattributed.
combined_cycle_note: Cleanview found almost no on-site heavy-duty (combined-cycle) turbines planned.
